# olf — dependency denylist
# =========================
# The dependency-audit CI gate (.github/scripts/dependency_audit.dart) fails the
# build if ANY package in the locked dependency graph (core/pubspec.lock,
# app/pubspec.lock — direct or transitive) matches a rule below.
#
# Why this exists: requirements.md §3 — "Zero third-party advertising or
# analytics SDKs." Embedding ad/analytics SDKs that can see health data is a
# direct legal-liability vector (Flo/FTC 2021; Meta/CIPA verdict 2025). This gate
# is a RELEASE BLOCKER (DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md p2.9).
#
# Rule syntax (one per line; '#' starts a comment):
#   package_name     exact pub package-name match
#   ~fragment        case-insensitive substring match (for vendor families)
#   re:pattern       case-insensitive regular-expression match
#
# Adding an entry: see docs/dependency-audit.md. Always include a one-line
# rationale after '#'. Removing an entry needs a reviewer sign-off in the PR.

# ---- Product / usage analytics -------------------------------------------------
firebase_analytics            # Google Analytics for Firebase — ships usage data to Google
firebase_analytics_web        # web impl of the above
amplitude_flutter             # Amplitude product analytics
amplitude                     # Amplitude product analytics
mixpanel_flutter              # Mixpanel product analytics
posthog_flutter               # PostHog product analytics
flutter_segment               # Twilio Segment CDP
segment_analytics             # Twilio Segment CDP (Actions client)
heap_flutter                  # Heap autocapture analytics
countly_flutter               # Countly analytics
countly_flutter_np            # Countly analytics (no-push variant)
matomo_tracker                # Matomo/Piwik analytics
flutter_matomo                # Matomo analytics
datadog_flutter_plugin        # Datadog RUM — session/behaviour telemetry
flutter_clarity               # Microsoft Clarity session recording
clarity_flutter               # Microsoft Clarity session recording

# ---- Advertising / attribution / MMPs ---------------------------------------
google_mobile_ads             # AdMob / Google Mobile Ads
google_ads                    # Google Ads
applovin_max                  # AppLovin MAX ad mediation
facebook_audience_network     # Meta Audience Network ads
unity_ads                     # Unity Ads
unity_ads_plugin              # Unity Ads
ironsource_mediation          # ironSource ad mediation
appodeal_flutter              # Appodeal ad mediation
~appsflyer                    # AppsFlyer attribution (appsflyer_sdk, …)
~adjust                       # Adjust attribution (adjust_sdk, …)
branch_sdk                    # Branch attribution / deep-link analytics
branch_io                     # Branch attribution
singular_flutter_sdk          # Singular attribution
kochava_tracker               # Kochava attribution
facebook_app_events           # Meta app-event tracking (attribution)
app_tracking_transparency     # iOS ATT prompt — only needed to enable cross-app tracking

# ---- Crash/telemetry SDKs that phone home to a third party by default -------
# (On-device or self-hosted crash handling is fine; these ship data off-device.)
firebase_crashlytics          # Crashlytics — crash traces to Google
sentry_flutter                # Sentry SaaS error monitoring
sentry                        # Sentry SaaS error monitoring
bugsnag_flutter               # Bugsnag SaaS error monitoring
instabug_flutter              # Instabug session/bug telemetry
embrace_io                    # Embrace mobile observability
